# 📢 NH Reader v0.7.2 — Official Code Signing, Full Desktop Installers & Pages Alignment

**Release Date:** 2026-10-01
**Tag:** [`v0.7.2`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.7.2)

---

## 🌟 What's in v0.7.2

NH Reader v0.7.2 introduces automated, zero-cost code signing integration across Windows and Android in our GitHub Actions pipeline, resolves an issue where desktop installers (`.exe`, `.msi`, `.deb`, `.AppImage`, `.dmg`) were skipped during release uploads, and aligns the documentation website with the official HELIX Origin portal theme.

---

### 🛡️ Official Code Signing in CI

Previous CI releases built on temporary GitHub Actions runners used throwaway self-signed certificates, which caused Windows SmartScreen to flag downloaded installers as an "Unknown Publisher / Untrusted Developer".

In v0.7.2:
- **Windows Authenticode Signing**: Injected official HELIX Origin signing certificates into GitHub Secrets. All Windows `.exe` and `.msi` installers are signed via `signtool.exe` with trusted Digicert timestamping.
- **Android Keystore Signing**: Added automated Android split APK signing using Java's `apksigner` and the official HELIX Origin release keystore.
- **Local Verification**: The public certificate (`certificates/nh-reader-codesign.cer`) allows local users to install the HELIX Origin root certificate once to trust all future releases.

---

### 📦 All Platform Installers Restored

The packaging workflow directory layout has been streamlined:
- In previous runs, installer files resided in nested builder directories (`nsis/`, `msi/`, `deb/`, `appimage/`, `dmg/`), causing `action-gh-release` to skip them.
- Artifacts are now flattened prior to release attachment, ensuring every platform installer format is published as a distinct, standalone asset.

---

### 🌐 Documentation Portal Theme Alignment

The project documentation website under `docs/` (`https://helix-origin.github.io/NH-Reader/`) has been updated with the navy blue, cyan (`#80d0f5`), and teal palette from the main [HELIX Origin organization portal](https://helix-origin.github.io).

---
